text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get started today too~!
First off, let's dig up some test sweet potatoes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The agricultural workshop held previously was so well-received
that it has been hosted regularly ever since.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Admirable! Working diligently today as well, I see!
To all of you gathered here—an announcement!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: We shall now hold a Harvest Festival!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! Harvesting so many crops alone is difficult!
Therefore, I plan to hold a grand event
so we can all harvest together!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds great!
Our field's been getting pretty lively lately too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking we might be short-handed for the harvest.
You're a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of the event—
many Umamusume gathered at the field.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone got their shovels?
Alright then, with all your might—DIIIG!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here goes—HEAVE-HO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh my...!?
Did I go too far...!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Maybe I put a little too much muscle into it.
Still, I bet that softened up the soil real good!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm, it won't budge easily... ngh!
In that case, with even greater strength—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up over there too!
If you yank the daikon radish too hard, it'll snap.
Loosen the dirt around it first, take it slow!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We can't just take it like this, can we?
We'll need to use some kind of tool...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, according to my research,
harvesting cabbage requires cutting off the core.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You really did your research~! Yup yup, we're using a kitchen knife,
but it's dangerous, so just watch me at first!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are we about to see Ace-san at her best?
Well then, allow me to observe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace was surrounded by smiling faces today as well.
Just as I was thinking how great it was that everyone seemed to be having fun—

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... Ace!
Would it be all right if we joined in today too...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
!!
You guys... came for me!
choice_data_list: (Those girls are the ones from the other day...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They're the classmates Katsuragi Ace had invited
to the farming experience before.
They turned her down back then, though...

text_block_list.name: Worrywart Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I heard some fun voices over here,
so I just had to check it out.

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It looks like fun... Do you mind if we
soak up the atmosphere for just a bit?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't hold back at 'a little'—
savor every bit of it to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
With this many veggies waiting for you,
you won't be getting bored anytime soon!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided,
first we gotta go grab a shovel!
Give me a shout when you get back!

text_block_list.name: Worrywart Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It could well be said that she is now an ace who leads everyone not only as an athlete, but in daily life as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those thoughts in mind,
just as I was about to return to the field work—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I noticed a significant change in the fig tree
that Katsuragi Ace and I were growing.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~~...! Good work!
Man, what a massive haul!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what's with that look?
You scheming something~?"
choice_data_list: There's something I want to see with you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hm, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
!
This is—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I see...! You finally bore fruit...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Man, you did amazing~!
Growing this much couldn't have been easy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fig tree we planted as a seedling and tended
to together for two years. The fruits of that labor
are right before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's even shaped like a real fig.
That's so awesome...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I looked at both the fig tree and Katsuragi Ace, a smile naturally came to my face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come rain or shine, enduring and persevering to grow
and bear fruit after years: the fig tree. And constantly
striving forward without slacking on effort: Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What're you grinning at?
choice_data_list: Ah, umm... I'm just so happy!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haha, you can say that again!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, to wrap up the harvest festival,
let's harvest this guy!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Yes! Got it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm with you, Trainer, all sorts of
fun and happy things just naturally come our way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It echoed the words she had shared with me before. But surely, that meant—
choice_data_list: I think it's because you're amazing.
I think it's because you're amazing

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I strongly believe it too.
That being with Katsuragi Ace brings along
all sorts of fun and happy things.
choice_data_list: Happiness naturally finds its way to you because you're always so positive.
Happiness comes to you because you're so positive.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
W-What's this all of a sudden?!
You're making me blush~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still... if that's the case,
how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's the two of us, all the fun and
happy things just come our way—
heheh, isn't that the greatest?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'm sure we'll go through all kinds of experiences from now on, both good and bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yet with her by my side, we can overcome anything with our heads held high. No matter the wall, no matter the hardship... I know we can."
